description:
Does Sitting Close to the TV Permanently Hurt Eyes? — Every parent warns you to scoot back from the TV—does it really break your eyes?
Kids science answer for "does sitting close to tv hurt eyes for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Modern screens do not permanently break eyes, though close staring without blinking causes tired dry eye muscles until you take a blink break.
